summary: Stellantis N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing the release date of its Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results scheduled for July 30, 2026, along with details for a related webcast and conference call. The filing is a routine earnings announcement and does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is purely informational, providing notice of an upcoming financial disclosure event without any transactional or corporate action component.
